# Sorry, how many stones did you say there were? | The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- Nerissa Ravencroft repeatedly struggles with game save states in The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, leading to significant loss of progress and humorous despair.
- She expresses an intense, existential fear of fish and the ocean, stemming from being landlocked, which she elaborates on at length.
- Nerissa frequently voices strong cravings for mac and cheese, often in moments of gaming frustration or triumph.
- She shares detailed critical analyses of musical theater productions and old internet creepypastas, engaging her audience in niche discussions.
- Nerissa offers humorous life advice on subjects like posture and recounts personal anecdotes, including a recent incident with her cat.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:47:04](#t=00:47:04) Catastrophic Game Save Disaster**: Nerissa accidentally reloads an old save point instead of creating a new one, losing 5-6 hours of game progress and expressing immense frustration, concluding she must restart the entire lost section.
- **[⏱️ 01:03:19](#t=01:03:19) The Mac and Cheese Plea**: Amidst game save state frustrations, Nerissa humorously, yet desperately, requests a viewer to make and hand-feed her heavily peppered mac and cheese while she plays.
- **[⏱️ 01:15:09](#t=01:15:09) Nerissa's Profound Fear of Fish**: Nerissa confesses her intense, existential fear of fish and the ocean, describing them as 'alien creatures' and vehemently explaining why they terrify her, even leading to a 'reverse mermaid' terror.
- **[⏱️ 02:16:47](#t=02:16:47) Are Viewers 'In My Walls'?**: Nerissa reacts with playful shock and suspicion when chat seems to know specific personal details about her, such as her mac and cheese preference, humorously questioning if they are 'in my walls'.
- **[⏱️ 02:34:04](#t=02:34:04) Life Advice: The Importance of Posture**: Nerissa abruptly, but passionately, delivers life advice, advocating for good posture as a key factor in attractiveness, stating that even the prettiest person will seem less so with poor posture.
- **[⏱️ 03:00:54](#t=03:00:54) Cat Peeing Incident and Cleaning Trauma**: Nerissa recounts a 'terrible experience' where her cat peed on her bed to demand food, prompting a detailed description of her extensive cleaning efforts and past trauma related to lingering cat pee smell.
- **[⏱️ 04:53:20](#t=04:53:20) Fairy Queen Revelation and Tree Transport**: Nerissa is suddenly transported to a 'fairy world' where the 'Queen of the Fairy World' addresses her as the 'Young Waker of the Winds,' revealing a destiny before she inexplicably finds herself inside a tree.

The VTuber expresses joy over finally figuring out how to sync their audio, allowing them to hum along to in-game music without sounding off-key, calling it 'the biggest upgrade'.
While facing in-game octopi, the VTuber humorously sings 'dooby dooby doo doo doo' and mentions imitating Charlotte from 'The Guy Who Doesn't Like Musicals'.
The VTuber creates 'Rock me like a hurricane' sound effects while navigating an in-game challenge, feeling like something is chasing them.
The VTuber expresses a strong desire to live in the aesthetically pleasing in-game house they encounter, asking chat if they would move there too.
While in the fairy fountain, the VTuber explains that all they know how to do is hum the 'too beautiful' song, implying its catchy nature.
The VTuber provides a live demonstration and explanation of the difference between reverb and echo sound effects, emphasizing how echo 'adds a difference'.
The VTuber comically tells an in-game pearl to 'Take your dang pearl and leave me alone' as they continue their objective, noting 'One pearl remains'.
The VTuber candidly criticizes the sailing mechanics in Wind Waker, stating 'I hate that. I'm not going to lie. Not my favorite thing in the world'.
The VTuber makes a humorous comment about missing their 'wife and child' in the context of Harvest Moon 64's gameplay, which they plan to play next.
The VTuber refers to three in-game characters as 'The Bermuda Triangle' and asks chat to find and share cute fan art of them together in the live tag.

chunks.summary: Nerissa Ravencroft begins a segment of her stream by humorously introducing herself and a 'new' playthrough of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, feigning unfamiliarity with the game and expressing awe at the 'cool' temple. She playfully apologizes for a late start. The conversation then shifts to snacks, with Nerissa revealing she had Doritos (nacho cheese), chocolate, and an Aquarius drink earlier. A recurring segment with her audience unfolds as she expresses comical alarm and suspicion when viewers seem to know specific personal details, such as her preference for mac and cheese with pepper, humorously questioning if they are 'in my walls.' She affirms her affection for her audience, who reciprocate with their 'obsession,' noting that her stream's antics are 'normal fair' for them. Nerissa shares her favorite types of peppers: shishito at yakidiku and jalapenos on Subway sandwiches in America. She then dives into internet culture, referencing the 'Smosh Zelda rap' and engaging in a playful age discussion with her chat, teasing them about being 'old internet people' and asserting her own vastly ancient status, stating 'none of you are coming close to my 10,000.' As she continues playing Wind Waker, she experiences a comedic reversal, initially intending to retrieve an item from an unopened chest but then quickly dismissing it as unimportant, claiming 'nothing of importance was in that chest' and that she 'would know.' The segment concludes with Nerissa expressing her dislike for the mice in the game and singing a short, humorous morning song.

highlights.description: Nerissa humorously introduces herself as 'Advents Devilish Diva, the one and only Nerissa Ravencross' and pretends it's her 'first time seeing any of this' during a playthrough of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker.
Nerissa reacts with playful shock and suspicion when chat seems to know specific personal details about her, asking 'Are you in my house? Are you guys in my walls? What the heck?'
Nerissa declares her love for her viewers, acknowledging their 'obsession' and noting that her stream's often bizarre content is 'normal fair for us.'
Nerissa quotes the 'Smosh Zelda rap' and uses it as a litmus test for her audience's age, associating it with 'old internet people.'
Engaging in a running gag about her age, Nerissa playfully tells her chat that 'none of you are coming close to my 10,000.'

After considering going back for an unopened chest in-game, Nerissa comically reverses her decision, stating, 'absolutely nothing of any importance was I would know. I was I I I would know. Just trust me. This wasn't a good idea.'
Nerissa sings a short, comical morning song: 'Good morning, Blondie. Rise and shine. I'll make you a cup of coffee, but I'll pour more into mine. Where the hell are we?'

chunks.summary: This segment features the VTuber navigating a game, possibly a Zelda-like title, encountering various challenges and expressing both frustration and humorous resignation. Initially, the VTuber engages in playful, aggressive banter, seemingly in character or reacting to game events. They then struggle with game mechanics, including 'stupid electric guys' and targeting issues, contemplating quitting due to difficulty. A notable part of the gameplay involves the VTuber deliberately backtracking to retrieve a chest, acknowledging it's likely unimportant but feeling compelled to collect it for 'joy and whimsy.' Interspersed with the gameplay and commentary, the VTuber unexpectedly delivers a recurring piece of life advice, passionately advocating for good posture as a key factor in attractiveness, stating that even the prettiest person will seem less so with poor posture. The segment also includes a brief reference to 'the king of red lions,' a character from The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, further cementing the likely genre of the game being played.

highlights.topic: East Coast Punch and Judy Show
highlights.description: The VTuber playfully or aggressively states, 'Your love's the best punch and Judy show in the whole East Coast.'
Amidst game frustration, the VTuber exclaims, 'I'm going to end it all. I'm going to end it all. I'm going to die here to these stupid electric guys.'
The VTuber humorously declares, 'Finally, you learned the command melody. I command that door to open.'
The VTuber explains backtracking for a chest, saying, 'I am going this way to get the chest that I forgot because there was nothing important. But now I'm going to feel bad if I don't get it.'
Upon opening the chest, the VTuber sarcastically comments, 'We got to get our joy and whimsy from the chest. Oh, yay. His joy penant. Oh, thank goodness.'
The VTuber abruptly offers life advice: 'Work on your posture. You have good posture. Women will love you.'

Reiterating the importance of posture, the VTuber states, 'No, all I'm saying is you can be the prettiest person alive, but if your posture is bad, suddenly you won't be so pretty anymore. I don't make the rules. That's just how it works.'

chunks.summary: The VTuber began the segment with an unexpected and humorous tangent on "gamer posture," advising viewers to correct their shrimping posture by working on back and neck muscles to increase their attractiveness, illustrating the point with Link's character model. This quickly transitioned into a segment of frustrated but comedic gameplay commentary, likely from a Legend of Zelda title, where the VTuber struggled with combat against a moving enemy, expressing exasperation and calling the experience their "personal brand of hell." Amidst the gameplay, they engaged in an exaggerated self-praise monologue about their "big brain," only to swiftly admit to an "oopsy whoopsy" and declare themselves the "hero of the wind/time" despite their gaming woes. The segment concluded with the VTuber taking a short break while attempting to locate a key and discovering they had maxed out their arrows unnecessarily.

highlights.description: No shrimping. Stop shrimping. Work on your back muscles so that and your neck muscles so you can actually support your your head and shoulders. You'll thank me. You'll thank me for this. If you if you fix that, your attractive level will increase.

They forced me to kill him with my sword. Brute force just like Ganon. What do you mean brute force? Is that I don't think that would have been a hard fight. I I'm pretty sure that fight would have been easy.
Man, I'm so smart. My brain is so big in my head. No brain has ever brained like my brain brained before. You know, the brain in my head, that's the brain of a freaking freak brainiac.
That was my mistake. I made I made it in in oopsy whoopsy. But I know now. I know now. The error of my ways. I'm the hero of the wind after all.
Guys, I suck. I hate being on a moving target, having to hit a moving target. Something about this is like my personal brand of hell.
Oh, thank goodness. There could be more arrows, I say with my arrows maxed out. Oops, my bad.

chunks.summary: The streamer begins by gushing over her cute cats, then recounts a recent 'terrible experience' where one of her cats peed on her bed after she didn't immediately feed him. She describes her quick reaction to clean the mess, using vinegar and washing the sheets, and her immediate fear that the smell would linger, recalling a past traumatic incident where her sister's cat's repeated accidents soaked into the carpet and required it to be ripped out. She details her thorough cleaning process, involving enzyme cleaner, white vinegar, baking soda, and even a black light to ensure no trace of the urine remained. She concludes the cat was merely annoyed and wanted to be fed, noting he shows no signs of a UTI, though she considers a vet visit. She humorously admits her pets are 'spoiled brats'. The segment then transitions to gameplay sounds and the streamer reacting to them, debating if a sound effect was a 'respawn' or 'being tortured' sound.

highlights.description: The streamer recounts the 'terrible experience' of her cat peeing on her bed to demand food, immediately prompting her to clean it.
She recalls a past traumatic event where her sister's cat repeatedly peed in her room, soaking into the carpet and requiring it to be ripped out due to the persistent smell.

highlights.topic: Fear of lingering cat pee smell
highlights.description: The streamer expresses her intense dread of the cat pee smell lingering, stating she 'literally wanted to die' from the constant odor in the past, and feared having to replace her mattress.
She details her successful cleaning process using enzyme cleaner, white vinegar, and baking soda, confirming that no smell remains due to her quick action.

highlights.topic: Black light confirmation and cat's motive
highlights.description: The streamer confirms no residual pee with a black light and concludes her cat peed on the bed purely because he wanted to be fed.
The streamer humorously admits that her pets are 'spoiled brats', justifying her cat's mischievous behavior.
The streamer reacts to a game sound effect, questioning if it was a 'respawn sound effect' or a 'being tortured sound effect', leading to a comedic disagreement.

chunks.summary: The VTuber navigated a challenging gameplay segment, initially struggling with an unintended solution to a puzzle before finding a way to progress. They humorously observed unique 'horn patterns' on in-game creatures, drawing a comparison to their own siblings. As they entered a significant boss battle, resource management became critical, with the VTuber strategically considering when to use 'grandma soup' healing items and panicking as their arrows dwindled. The boss fight proved intense and frustrating, especially upon realizing that running out of arrows would reset the boss's progress. Despite multiple setbacks, including falling off the edge, the VTuber persevered and ultimately triumphed on their third attempt, successfully completing the challenge and unlocking the next path while reflecting on the arduous journey.

highlights.description: During a challenging moment in the game, the VTuber desperately calls out to their in-game character, Link, expressing a fear of imminent defeat.

The VTuber vents frustration about receiving a seemingly useless 'feather' as a reward when a much-needed healing 'heart' would have been more beneficial, sarcastically questioning the game's choices.
In the middle of a boss battle, the VTuber expresses panic as they realize they are almost out of arrows, quickly adding a sarcastic remark to the unhelpful advice 'Don't miss'.
After accidentally falling off the edge during the boss fight, the VTuber expresses disbelief and frustration, questioning if they are truly 'dead' and forced to restart the challenging encounter.

chunks.summary: Nerissa Ravencroft begins the segment by enthusiastically describing a scene, possibly a game or a dream, where she is Link and has been saved by a 'Grandma'. The narrative quickly shifts to Link's 'true trial' beginning after obtaining an item from a castle, which is revealed to be the Temple of Time, leading to the Master Sword. Nerissa then roleplays the scene of Link acquiring the Master Sword, emphasizing the blade of evil's bane. She then goes on a tangent, humorously misremembering details about Zelda lore, specifically the Seven Sages from Ocarina of Time, struggling to recall names like Impa and Nabooru, and comically scolding herself for forgetting them despite having just played the game. The segment concludes with Nerissa 'testing out' the Master Sword by fighting enemies, explaining her combat strategy of cutting off armor and disarming them, and humorously deciding she doesn't need to kill all the enemies.

highlights.description: Nerissa recounts a vivid scene where Link is saved and told his true trials will begin once he takes his first step beyond the ring of light, eventually leading to the Temple of Time and the Master Sword.
After a humorous comment about Link needing to work on his aim, Nerissa says, 'He's like, Bro, I can't breathe.' Like, he can breathe. He's like, 'This is weird. I'm a fish now.'
Nerissa dramatically roleplays the moment Link is acknowledged as a hero and presented with the Master Sword, 'the blade of evil's bane,' which can banish Ganon.

Upon receiving the Master Sword, Nerissa exclaims, 'I'm scared. I'm scared. I'm scared. I'm scared. Excalibur. Excalibur from United King. I'm looking for her. I'm going to California. Master Sword. Master Sword. Oh no.'

Nerissa attempts to recall the Seven Sages from Ocarina of Time, struggling to remember names like Impa and Nabooru, eventually scolding herself: 'Nerissa Ravencroft. You literally just played this game.'

Nerissa describes her combat approach with the Master Sword: 'I need to cut off their armor and then they're cooked apart from just attacking me. There's not much they can do. And then I just knock their sword out of their hand.'
After detailing her fight, Nerissa humorously concludes, 'Oh my god. I don't think I need to kill these guys, mind you. I'll probably just skip it. So beautiful.'

chunks.summary: The VTuber engages in a roleplay narrative, likening their actions to Link from The Legend of Zelda, fighting monsters in a castle to rescue Princess Zelda. They express confidence in their combat prowess, humorously taunting invisible enemies and commenting on the idea of 'friendly fire.' A moment of frustration arises when a door won't open due to a missed enemy, prompting the VTuber to question the game's mechanics and her chat's observations. The conversation then pivots to game progression, encountering an 'invisible barrier,' and the concept of a 'Wind Waker Barrier Skip' often used in speedrunning. After reading dialogue from the 'King of Red Lions,' the VTuber explicitly states her intention not to speedrun, preferring to play organically to save Link's sister. Despite this, she expresses keen interest in learning about the history of the Wind Waker Barrier Skip and asks her chat to put a video link in her live tags for later, being mindful of potential spoilers. The segment concludes with the VTuber planning to find the next fairy fountain, as chat warns about potential spoilers from 'Periscope' (likely referring to the barrier skip).

highlights.description: The VTuber, roleplaying as Link, confidently declares their mission to protect the castle, defeat evil, and rescue Princess Zelda, taunting unseen foes with 'Get good loser!'
Expressing humorous frustration, the VTuber questions why a door remains closed despite having 'killed everything,' realizing they must have 'missed one' enemy.
Commenting on chat's 'friendly fire' remarks, the VTuber humorously states, 'This is why I fight alone. It's a lonely life, but it's my life.'
Encountering an 'invisible barrier,' the VTuber expresses confusion and questions the game's progression, wondering if they should simply leave or if they're missing something.

highlights.topic: Commitment to Organic Play, Not Speedrunning
highlights.description: After hearing about speedrun strategies like the 'Wind Waker Barrier Skip,' the VTuber firmly states, 'I'm not going to speedrun... We will continue our game play organically. I have a sister to save. We're not speedrunners.'
Despite deciding against speedrunning, the VTuber expresses a strong interest in learning the 'history of Wind Waker Barrier Skip' and asks chat to save a link for later viewing.

chunks.summary: The VTuber is playing a game, discussing a past instance of losing their game save and having to restart, which led to not encountering a specific 'cyclone frog' in the current playthrough. They corrected their memory about the stream's starting point (Tower of Gods). The main objective involves searching for a game character referred to as 'the king in the north' and figuring out how to utilize tornados or cyclones for movement. An in-game character teaches them the 'Ballad of Gales,' granting the ability to use cyclones for oceanic travel. Following this, the VTuber sets course for Windfall Island to locate a fairy fountain. During their journey, they express bewilderment about the game's 'feed the fish' mechanic, admitting they've never used it. An in-game hint is provided about acquiring 'magic armor' on Windfall Island through flattery. The segment concludes with the VTuber realizing the extensive sailing and fish interaction required to fully complete their sea chart.

highlights.description: The VTuber reflects on losing a game save and restarting, noting they haven't encountered the 'cyclone frog' in the current timeline.
The VTuber corrects their memory, acknowledging that the stream initially started at the Tower of Gods.
An in-game character praises the VTuber's 'mastery of the air' and teaches them the 'Ballad of Gales,' allowing the use of cyclones for travel.
The VTuber expresses confusion and a lack of memory regarding the 'feed the fish' game mechanic, stating they never did it once.
Reacting to a viewer's comment, the VTuber humorously questions the made-up word 'globing' in the context of fish.
An in-game character provides a hint about 'magic armor' available on Windfall Island, suggesting flattery to obtain it.
The VTuber realizes they need to sail extensively and find fish to complete their sea chart, expressing regret for not doing it sooner.

chunks.summary: Amelia Watson continued her gameplay, encountering what she humorously referred to as a 'Kraken' and expressed frustration over missing in-game cues. She received information from an in-game character about Tingle, a map decipherer who charges exorbitant fees, leading Amelia to express a humorous sense of betrayal. The discussion then shifted to treasure hunting, with the character detailing 'weird rings of light' and 'special lights' indicating treasure locations, prompting Amelia to jokingly admit she 'can't read' when clarifying between treasure charts and chests. She struggled to locate a specific fish in a dangerous area and learned about a 'famed pictographer' on Windfall Island, comically questioning what a 'pictograph' even is. Amelia noted the 'polite' enemies for waiting during her conversations and expressed confusion over her map's display. She experimented with different bait, discovering one was meant for seagulls, and received further information about hidden treasure on Outset Island. The segment culminated in Amelia expressing significant stress and near-frustration with the game's difficulty, before hearing a lore tidbit about a fairy scared off by 'big otos,' which she worried might have eaten her. Finally, Amelia voiced curiosity about what happens if she sails past the map's boundary.

highlights.description: Amelia reacts with surprise and frustration to an in-game 'Kraken' event.
Amelia expresses humorous disappointment upon learning Tingle charges high fees for map deciphering, questioning his friendship.
Amelia makes a self-deprecating joke about not being able to read when clarifying in-game item descriptions.
Amelia comically questions the definition of a 'pictograph' despite being given information about a famed pictographer.
Amelia sarcastically thanks in-game enemies for waiting while she was having a conversation.
Amelia candidly admits to being on the verge of extreme frustration due to the game's stressful nature.
Amelia expresses concern that 'big otos' might have eaten a beautiful fairy mentioned in the game's lore.

chunks.summary: The VTuber continues her journey sailing the in-game seas, focusing on filling out the map by finding new areas and interacting with an NPC fish. This fish repeatedly appears to offer cryptic clues about hidden secrets and treasures in exchange for bait, addressing the player as 'small fry'. The clues include information about an item that grants super strength located four squares north and three squares east of Fire Mountain, an old master swordsman on an island due east, and a vanishing treasure that can be made permanent. The VTuber expresses both curiosity and frustration with these hints, at one point considering a detour but ultimately deciding to prioritize current exploration as she can warp later. Amidst the gameplay, she humorously declares her desire for macaroni and cheese, suggesting it's the only thing that will make her 'feel better'. She also voices significant frustration with the game's treasure hunting mechanics and the fish's often misleading or evasive nature, leading to exasperated reactions like wanting to 'strangle that fish'. The segment concludes with her still navigating the waters, encountering another 'small fry' NPC, and receiving a final cryptic hint about a weird treasure hunter with a 'huger' pack than any she's seen.

highlights.description: The VTuber reacts to the NPC's unsolicited advice, exclaiming that her plan is being ruined.
The VTuber passionately declares her need for macaroni and cheese, stating it's the only thing that will make her feel better.
Exasperated by the NPC fish, the VTuber humorously threatens to 'strangle that fish'.
The VTuber expresses strong dislike and frustration for the game's treasure hunting mechanic.
The VTuber relays a peculiar clue from an NPC about a 'weird guy' with an unusually 'huge' pack, found on an island.

chunks.summary: Nerissa Ravencroft navigates the in-game world, sailing and listening to an NPC, Small Fry, who details the use of a grappling hook to steal 'joy pendants' from 'beoblins'. She expresses frustration with the game's progression, realizing certain areas are inaccessible. Small Fry later provides convoluted directions for finding a treasure inside a volcano and a power to freeze objects. Nerissa seeks advice on obtaining bait and changing the time of day, eventually being directed by chat to a character at Dragon Roost. She enthusiastically learns the 'Song of Passing' from a gravestone character, hoping to shift the day-night cycle, but is met with confusion when nothing immediately happens. After purchasing bait and humorously dismissing in-game mail, she is suddenly transported to a 'fairy world'. There, the 'Queen of the Fairy World' addresses her as the 'Young Waker of the Winds', revealing a destiny involving protecting individuals. The segment concludes with Nerissa bewildered, finding herself inexplicably inside a tree.

highlights.description: An NPC explains that a grappling hook can be used to steal 'joy pendants' from 'beoblins' found on lookout platforms.
Nerissa playfully anticipates chat mocking her for trying to access something she can't yet, calling herself 'silly little Noissa'.
Nerissa expresses her dislike for the 'Small Fry' character after receiving complex directions for finding a treasure and a freezing power.
Nerissa enthusiastically reacts to a character at a gravestone attempting to recall a 'magical dance' to change day to night, eventually recognizing and learning the 'Song of Passing'.
After learning the Song of Passing, Nerissa is confused when nothing immediately happens, asking 'Hey, what's the matter? Nothing happened. Nothing at all. Why?'
Nerissa vehemently dismisses receiving in-game mail, repeatedly stating 'I don't care' and questioning its importance.
Nerissa is suddenly transported to a fairy world where the 'Queen of the Fairy World' addresses her as the 'Young Waker of the Winds' and reveals a destiny involving protecting dear individuals.

highlights.topic: Why Am I In A Tree?
highlights.description: The segment ends abruptly with Nerissa bewildered, questioning her sudden placement inside a tree after the encounter with the Fairy Queen.

chunks.summary: The segment begins with the VTuber attempting to navigate an in-game situation, expressing frustration over getting a boat unstuck and curiosity about unexplored areas. This quickly transitions into an impromptu musical interlude, where the VTuber sings the credit theme from "Adventure Time," followed by a heartfelt and humorous rendition of Marceline's iconic song, "Daddy, Why Did You Eat My Fries?" Returning to gameplay, they engage in a comical interaction with an in-game fish, first threatening it, getting attacked, and then attempting to bait it. The discussion then moves to game lore, mentioning a beautiful fairy and mysterious rings in the sea, which prompts the VTuber to establish a clear boundary regarding backseating, stating that advice is only welcome if explicitly asked for. As the game progresses, the VTuber struggles with a seemingly inaccessible door, contemplating creative solutions like blowing up a wall, and then roleplays an in-game dialogue referencing Ganondorf and the Master Sword. The segment concludes with an extended and increasingly exasperated boss battle sequence where the VTuber attempts to deflect projectiles in a 'tennis' like manner, humorously lamenting their performance despite eventually achieving success.

highlights.description: The VTuber spontaneously sings the entire credit theme song from the animated series 'Adventure Time'.

highlights.topic: Marceline's 'Daddy, why did you eat my fries?' Song
highlights.description: The VTuber delivers an emotional and humorous full rendition of Marceline's song from 'Adventure Time' about her dad eating her fries.
The VTuber humorously threatens an in-game fish, gets attacked for it, then comically tries to lure it with snacks.
The VTuber clearly states that backseating is only acceptable if they explicitly ask for help during gameplay.
The VTuber reads aloud an encouraging in-game dialogue about Link's strength against a fierce foe, then comically reacts to the advice.
After successfully deflecting a projectile in a boss battle, the VTuber triumphantly shouts, 'Loser. Loser. Loser.'

chunks.summary: In this segment, the VTuber wraps up a session of Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, focusing on the in-game goal of saving their sister. They discuss the remaining dungeon count, expressing mild frustration with the perceived length, and jokingly admit to not filling out the map, stating they've gotten far without it. The VTuber then provides their upcoming stream schedule, announcing the next Zelda stream for the 24th at 8 PM, a members-only stream on the 22nd at 8 PM, and a potential Advent collaboration on the 23rd. They thank both the live audience and the VOD viewers, reflecting on the fun they had despite a hectic weekend, and apologizing to VOD viewers for any early struggles during the stream.

highlights.description: The VTuber asks for an estimation on how much longer it will take to save their in-game sister in Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker.
The VTuber expresses surprise that filling out the in-game map is not mandatory, noting they've progressed far without doing so.
The VTuber expresses excitement and disbelief that they will finally be able to save their sister in the next play session.
The VTuber announces their next Legend of Zelda stream will be on the 24th at 8 PM, followed by a members-only stream on the 22nd at 8 PM, and a potential Advent collab on the 23rd.
The VTuber apologizes to the VOD audience for any suffering or struggles they had to witness at the beginning of the stream.
